full_judgment: 4. The defendant was contesting the suit by filing a written statement, denying the title of the plaintiffs over the suit-land. His contention was that RS Plot No. 3212 appertaining to Khatian No. 756 under mouja Mazigao, police station Mirershorai, district Chittagong originally belonged to Ahmedur Rahman. After his death his daughter Hosneara Begum became the owner. She sold out 0.111/4 acre from said plot to Nurul Afsar and Habibur Rahman by a registered sale deed dated 16-1-1962. Habibur Rahman had erected a pucca shop on the land of his part and rented it to the defendant. He further posited that Habibur Rahman died leaving behind his one brother and two sisters as his legal heirs and successors who sold out 0.03 acre of land and the shop premises to the defendant by a sale deed dated 6-5-197. It was further stated that the plaintiffs were unsuccessful in the village Court. As he was owner of the shop premises and complicated question of title was involved in the suit, he prayed for return of the plaint under section 23 of the Small Causes Court Act.
